source: Do you remember the first time we went to the beach, my dear?
Of course I do! You didn't have any facial hair yet back then. It was adorable.
Oh, and you still had your short, wavy hair.
Yes. Time flies really fast, Osman.
Hmmm... Do you think it would've been better if we'd got married on the beach?
Why? The Church was an excellent choice.
I know. I just thought it might have been more romantic if we were on the beach.
Well, I, for one, think our marriage ceremony was the best.
Sorry I kept coming home late...
It's okay, dear. Do your best for this town.
But promise me that you won't get sick.
I promise.
Do you have anything else for our prayers today?
I want to pray for my husband, Sister Socellia.
Have faith, Cassandra. May the gods keep you and your family safe.
Oh, I do have faith, and I always will.
Have you tried singing before, Cassandra?
No, I haven't, Sister...
You have a beautiful voice. You should try it!
Really? Maybe I'll try some day.
Have you ever tried doing meditation?
I have, but it was too difficult for me.
Oh my! Why is that?
Every time I close my eyes, I almost fall asleep…
I think the Willow Waters Bathhouse is doing well. Don't you agree, Olive?
Yes. Thank you for your assistance, Cassandra.
It's thanks to both of us.
You're right. Oh, Cassandra! I'm so fortunate to have a friend like you.
How's Osman doing?
He's busy with his duties like always.
I see. Being a police officer isn't an easy job.
Yes. I wish I could help him somehow.
Here we are. Another day, another night.
Is there something wrong, Olive?
Nothing... It's really nothing...
Cheer up, Olive!
It is still hard to believe we're police officers now!
You were going on about how you'd try to help everyone once you got in.
I was so nervous, I didn't know what I was saying!
That's fair. I was anxious, too. Who'd have thought we'd both get accepted?
Can you believe it? I've received a report about a missing fish again!
That must be another case involving Kipps, right?
You betcha. Why don't we have a law for cats?
You wanna try to arrest a cat?
What would Osman say if he found out we're drinking right now?
He'd probably say "you're great at doing nothing."
Do you think so? Let's find out together!
Wait... That's supposed to be a joke, right?
What are you up to, Dean?
Hmmm... Just patrolling the area...
Ooh, anything up?
E-err... I shouldn't talk about it...
Dean, what's wrong with Derrek?
Huh, what is it...?
He always has that scary look every time I look at him.
Only he can answer that...
Any interesting news from the Lazy Bowl Tavern?
Nothing new. It's boring, as usual...
How about the omelette? It was delicious.
Oh... I thought it was something else...
Don't you have anything else to do, Zeke?
Actually, I do. I need to play with Kipps and take a nap later on.
Why am I asking you that question...
Are you done with your questions? Stop wasting my time, Dean!
Are you sure you were only "lazing" around in the park, Zeke?
Hmm? Sorry, you'll have to speak louder. I'm old, you know!
Are you sure you were only "lazing" around?!
Oh, yeah. Of course!
How's life as a police officer?
My life's been great!
And how about you, Zeke?
It's been complicated but... nothing like you!
Hehehehehehehehe...
What is it?
Hehehehehehehehehehehehehehhe...
Stop it! You're freaking me out!
Hey, there's a man standing behind you. Hehehe...
Errr... Could you please tell him to leave me alone?
Don't worry. It's just Caenus. He just wants to get to know you better. Hehehe...
Oh, come on...
Can you send a letter to my friend? Hehehehe...
Sure. Where does your friend live? The capital?
I think he was in Caenus' realm last week.
I-I'm afraid I can't deliver that letter to him.
Can you please tell Dan not to wear his hat while taking a bath?
He was supposed to store it in his locker!
I'm sorry, Olive. I won't do it again!
Hey, wait... Why am I the one being scolded?
Do you know exactly when my packages will arrive, Dev?
Soon! Anyway, have you ever visited the capital before?
Nope. But if you were willing to take my job here, I would.
I have no plans for a career change.
Someone left their underwear at the Willow Waters Bathhouse recently. Outrageous!
Why are you telling me this?
Because I think it's yours!
I-I don't think so...
How'd you get your title? The Legendary Blacksmith!
I don't really know, to be honest.

Good morning. I've got some bad news, I'm afraid.
It seems that you weren't able to treat our villager's ailment in good time.
We had no option but to take them away and look for other forms of treatment.
I hope this doesn't happen again.
Forrest and I have tried our best.
We just can't get the amount you wanted.
It will take a couple more weeks...
Got it.
Do you remember when we last fixed this machine?
Hey, it's the chemist.
We're blaming it on the harsh weather in this cold place.
I swear we must've fixed it six times already.
Asking Opalheart for help?
I suppose it wouldn't hurt to ask. Could you do that?
Oh, you have the badge you need. Great.
This machine is supposed to keep the geyser in check so we can access the Barren Wasteland, but...
It exploded many years ago, and hasn't been touched since.
And now your badge has been upgraded, you could help us with something.
I know you're not necessarily an expert on pipes, but still...
How about asking Yorn? He fixed the Tavern's pipes himself. He might have an idea.
Hey, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}. What brings you here?
What's this?
It's chemical residue from past accidents.
The Medical Association caused this damage to our island.
There's other residue elsewhere like this.
I don't really know the details of the accident.
But I heard there were some casualties.
The accident killed off some of the vegetation around here.
And there's nothing we can do about it.
Osman's father probably knew something about it.
He was one of the police officers who led the rescue operation during the accident.
Osman might know something if you're still curious.
Oh wow!
You've totally cleared the area up.
Are you looking for materials here on Glaze Iceberg?
You're really keen on finding areas that are full of resources, aren't you?
Maybe you should talk to Myer about it.
It wouldn't hurt to ask him, right?
Chemist, wait. You can't go there yet.
You can't access this area for the time being.
By the looks of it, I don't think you've got permission yet.
For now, I'd suggest you discuss it with Myer.
Reyner's request?
I'll need to check on the documents at the Ranger Post.
Come on, follow me.
I think Forrest forgot about that request of his.
This request's just lying on the floor.
No wonder he hasn't received what he requested.
You want to help us fulfil his order?
Alright, I'll let you have this request note.
Be sure to give the materials directly to him later, okay?
{[CHARACTER_NAME]}, what are you doing here?
Oh, so you know about the Black Lotus too, do you?
Lately, it's been drawing my attention too. I've been keeping an eye on this place for a while.
As you can see, the flower's in a sad state.
This unusual fungus around it must be the issue.
I've been trying to keep the fungus off the flower, but it just keeps coming back.
If it's not fixed soon, the Black Lotus might go extinct forever...
You'll try to get rid of the fungus with a potion?
That's good to hear. I hope it works.
I'm counting on you, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}!
You've finished the cure?!
Alright, let's go!
The fungus is gone and the lotus is flourishing again!
Look how beautiful they are...
Oh, sorry, I got a little carried away there.
Once again, thank you for the help!
So there's supposed to be something behind this?
Wow, you can actually get inside here.
How did it get buried like this, though?
Look at this mess...
Is this really the one you were looking for? It's in terrible condition.
This cave is quite close to the geyser, which is probably why it got blocked off.
I can't imagine the chemists were capable even of sealing the cave off, let alone of burying it.
But what's this empty slot right here?
It's finally finished...
It worked!
We've done it, haven't we?!
Why am I not surprised to find you in such a weird place, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}...?
That's a Cold Bloom, but we're seeing fewer of them now, because of the extreme weather.
And the situation's getting worse now the soil temperature's been affected.
You want to restore the Cold Blooms? That would be great!
I'll let you have this flower, but promise me you'll succeed!
Sorry, I can't help you with that one. I really don't know much about soil.
Maybe you could ask around the town? I'm sure someone's looked into it.
Hey, I have a report for you. Please follow me.
The number of patients at the Clinic has significantly increased.
Please treat them as soon as possible! I don't want this situation to get any worse.
We're relying on you, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
Hey, are you looking for something?
We're selling materials we gathered around Moonbury.
If you need any materials urgently, feel free to come by.
We will periodically update the lists of materials over time, too.
Thank you for your help, Reyner. It turned out so well.
I can finally grow plants on my own.
Well, I want to thank you, too. Reyner was able to fix my grow box today.
Oh, you didn't know? It's a tool that helps you grow and harvest plants at home.
Hence the name.
Though yours might be a little different from mine. But they should work the same.
Hello, you two. Hope I made it in time.
Wow, there are three of them! The previous chemist must've used them a lot.
And your work is as astounding as ever, Reyner.
Anyway, now you'll need the seeds of plants you want to grow.
And I can provide you with those.
It's easier to show you - please follow me.
Now, you see this garden? I've been farming all the plants that have been discovered in Moonbury.
I can share the seed of a plant with you once you've collected a certain number of plants.
I'll notify you on the Bulletin Board when the seeds are ready. Sounds good?
It's nice to have more people interested in gardening.
There you are, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
Since you've collected enough plants, I'll give you the seed.
Take good care of it, okay?

Cassandra is a diligent and hardworking woman who spends her days assisting her friend, Olive, to run Moonbury's Bathhouse.

She is married to Osman, Moonbury's Chief of Police.

Due to her husband's demanding work, Cassandra spends more time at home alone and it makes her uneasy.

She doesn't want to let Osman know in case it distracts him from his duties.

Since her last dose of medication, Cassandra's condition doesn't seem to have improved.

Upon learning of this, {[CHARACTER_NAME]} discusses it with Osman, even though the latter knows little about it due to his work.

Osman has promised that he will pay more attention to Cassandra. There is no better medicine than being cared for by someone you love.
Greetings! I'm Cassandra, co-owner of Moonbury's Bathhouse, and the Chief of Police's wife.
I hope Osman doesn't treat you harshly - he doesn't like strangers!
How are you enjoying your stay?
I ought to come up with an innovative bath soap recipe.
Snowberry, perhaps?
Hmm... Maybe not.
Have you tried the baths at the Willow Waters Bathhouse lately?
They have a new jasmine soap.
Don't you ever feel anxious when someone needs your help?
Could my anxiety attacks come back?
It's okay, because I can count on you, right?
Is taking care of others a passion of yours?
Or perhaps just your job, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}?
I think my health is getting better.
I'm glad to see you, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
You weren't just there when we needed you...
You also taught me a lot about opening up to others, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
My husband and I are ever grateful to you, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
It has been a long journey of acceptance...
I'm glad things are getting better for us.
You knew I liked this tea? Thank you!
I appreciate your kindness.
You are very kind for giving me this, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
Thank you for your gift. I really appreciate it.
That's awfully kind of you, but you already gave me something.
You've helped me, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}. I'm forever in your debt.
Thanks. I feel much better.
Well... my body is still sore, but better than before, I suppose...
It seems that no one trusts you, Chemist. Please be careful.
Umm... Hello?
Good day to you, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
Come in!
{[CHARACTER_NAME]}? Is there anything I can help you with?
Oh, are you here to see how I'm getting on? Thank you...
You see... I've been having anxiety attacks.
They've been happening for quite some time.
Would you mind brewing me a potion that could help?
I hope I'm not asking too much, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
Is the potion finished?
I think I'll have a drink right now.
Phew...
I can feel myself relaxing already.
Anxiety attacks are really bothersome, mainly because they're unexpected.
My husband? No. He doesn't know anything...
He's so busy with his duties. I don't want to bother him.
Anyway, thank you so much for your help.
I-I'm fine...
It was my anxiety again? B-But I'm fine...
I just don't want to bother you...
Every time you come back from work, I know that you've been through a rough day.
And I don't want to cause you unnecessary problems.
But what about your duties and everything?
T-Thank you, dear...
I promise I won't be like this any more. I'm glad to have you by my side.
And I can't thank you enough for everything, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
Excuse me, dear. I've baked some bread.
What's going on here, dear?
But, dear...
My husband seems to have been in a bad mood lately. He can't concentrate very well.
Oh my... He should take a break. He's been working too hard lately...
But... we're talking about Osman here. I doubt he wants to have a day off.
Hmmm... I'm still not sure.
I'm not sure the new aroma is very popular, Olive.
Hmm? Oh, welcome!
I didn't notice you there.
Well, that can't be helped.
How about we ask {[CHARACTER_NAME]} to create a signature aromatic for us?
Of course! There are so many resources we could use. Right, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}?
We shouldn't follow trends from other places. Let's set our own trend instead!
So, this is the new aromatic?
I'll put it on our list and see what feedback we get from our customers.
How lovely that you're enjoying our new aroma!
Thank you for letting us know! We hope to see you again soon.
{[CHARACTER_NAME]}!
Your new aromatic's a huge hit.
Everyone loves it, and we're almost out of stock.
I think we might need to restock soon.
Anyway, thank you for the recipe!
I'm sure it's going to make a lot of people happy.
You've done a great job, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
Hmm?
What's the occasion? You usually just eat whatever I bring without much comment.
You know it's not like that... It's just, it's not like you to make requests... That's all.
Anything for you, Olive.
What's happening, dear? Where are you taking me?
Oh, Osman, dear... Is this what I think it is?
Oh... The flowers, the drinks, the sunset... It's exactly like our first date. It's... perfect.
The Sausage Rolls... I made one for Olive just recently... Was she involved in setting all this up?
Of course not. I'm so grateful that we're surrounded by kind people here...
I'll be sure to make them something later as a token of our gratitude.
And Olive... That silly girl. I had no idea.
And this root beer is just as refreshing! Do you remember spilling some on your uniform that day?
So our date was cut short because I had to run home and wash your uniform!
Indeed...
Me too, Osman. Happy anniversary, dear.
Nice to meet you!
You must be the new chemist.
We've already talked to the mayor. He's waiting for you up ahead by the town gate.
Oh, don't let her worry you! Hey, you brought along your medical journal, right?
Remember to check and update it regularly.
Well, you'd better get going.
But I'm excited to see what happens!
There you are. I wasn't expecting you to be able to cure the Mayor's daughter so fast.
Wow, congratulations!
And a report to write about this milestone.
Hmm... It's going to be a long report. I might leave it to you, Moira.
Hello, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
I was just checking on my latest bit of DIY.
Here, take a look at this.
Now, look what we've got here.
We've worked together with Myer to install this box just for you.
It's called a post drop box.
If you make too many potions, you can sell some by dropping them in the box.
Our courier will collect them for you.
This little fella here will be the one who collects your potions and sends them to the Medical Association.
He comes every day to check on the post drop box.
He'll be here at 17:00 sharp!
So be sure to drop all your potions before then, got it?
Don't worry, we'll buy any potions you put in the box.
I hope this will help you along on your mission.
It's good to see you again, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}!
I've got to say, we're all pretty impressed with our little chemist here.
We've decided to put you up for promotion.
And of course, we want you to help as many people as possible here.
So I'm here to inform you that you are eligible to take the chemistry test!
Ta-daaaaaa!
Complete this test, and you'll get a licence to produce a more powerful potion.
One that can heal even more complex diseases.
Which will be good for this lovely town too, right?
I thought you were going to just stand there and watch me leave, Mr Secretary.
I know you can do it, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}!
Hi, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}!
And hello, Mr Secretary!
With pleasure, Doc.
Here's your new licence.
Onwards and upwards, Chemist!
By the way, Doc, we've got a train to catch...
Good to see you again, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}!
After your test, we talked everything over.
Dr Nestor is very happy with everything you've achieved here.
And what's more surprising, Moira feels the same!
It's a miracle, right? I never thought I'd have a discussion with Moira that didn't turn into an argument...
She's deadly serious and a total cynic, but also very smart. A perfect model student. Bo-ring!
Oops, sorry... That was a bit off-topic...
I'm here because Dr Nestor wants to give you this letter.
It's a letter of recommendation!
We really hope that you'll keep working and studying on this island!
Oh, and what I said about Moira just now... Let's keep it between us, okay?
I'll see you soon, little Chemist.
Well, well...
We meet again, Mr Secretary!
I told you before, Moira!
This kid is special, talented, like we've been saying!
Why don't you do the honours, Moira?
No need to be a wallflower! You're also thrilled for {[CHARACTER_NAME]}, right?
There you go, little Chemist.
Good to see you again, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
I hope you've been enjoying yourself!
And you too, Mr Secretary...
Okay, point taken.
Now, having seen what you've accomplished so far...
We'd like to give you one final test.
Pass this test, and you'll be eligible to rise even higher in the profession.
{[CHARACTER_NAME]} will be fine, Moira. You worry too much!
You just tell Xiao when you're done with the test, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}!
You still worried about our little Chemist?
I can't wait to know the result!
In the meantime, keep your fingers crossed and keep helping Moonbury.
Moira will be praying for you too, don't worry.
Now, please excuse us, everyone.
Good to see you, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}!
Me and the other Medical Association members have come to meet you.
They're waiting at the Clinic now. Let's get going.
I told you, Moira, our little friend here has great potential.
Oh right, hang on.
There you go. Your new licence.
To see little {[CHARACTER_NAME]} grow up so fast... I might actually cry.
But you agree with me, don't you?
Little Chemist! So good to see you here! On a morning stroll, are you?
Look at all these pretty flowers and butterflies! I could admire them for hours!!
Why am I here? Oh, just visiting.
I've been here many times, but never actually stopped to appreciate the town itself.
So here I am.
It was a long and arduous trip, so I'm sure you won't mind accompanying me for a while, will you?
Pretty please?
Great! Let's sit down over there! I'd like to enjoy the view.
Ah... This is pure bliss...
Fresh air, greenery, and wow, what a view...
The capital can be a bit... suffocating sometimes, you know?
All the smog, bricks and people...
Can you blame me for wanting to escape from time to time? Hahaha.
I hope you won't mind me enjoying a moment of comfortable silence...
Alright, I feel better already!
Next stop, I heard Moonbury has a lovely beach!
Oooh, the feeling of soft sand under my feet... I'm so excited!!
But if you think I came all this way just to enjoy the fresh air, you're gravely mistaken... Tee-hee!
I know you have work to do, so I won't keep you.
But if by chance you had any free time, I'd love to have you show me around!
It would be awesome to have a local giving me a tour, after all.
I'm glad to see that you feel like one of them now. You look happier!
Well then, I'll be looking forward to my tour.
{[CHARACTER_NAME]}, you came!
This place is gorgeous, isn't it? I can feel the sea breeze on my face and hear the sound of ocean waves.
I didn't realise until I saw it properly.
Now, how about you take me on a mini tour?
My, this is an... interesting boat.
It belongs to pirates?! You're not pulling my leg, are you?
Actual pirates, with a peg leg and a hook for an arm?
So, there were real pirates...
Wait, they're not going to attack or rob me, are they?
I'll behave myself around here, then...
This corn is awesome! It's a real treat!
Hey, Corn Boy! This corn is CORNTASTIC!
Hahaha. That boy is funny!
Is Corn Boy also a pirate, then?
I-I think I need a drink to wash this corn down.
I'm going to look for a tavern of some sort.
I hope I'll see you later, little Chemist!
Little Chemist! Hey!
Moonbury's no joke! This is the best drink I've had in a while!
I'd say only a few bars in the capital can top this.
Grizzly Guy here clearly knows his drinks.
Well, I think it's time to finally tell you the truth...
Actually, I didn't come here for a holiday.
...Alright, maybe I did, but that's not the main reason I'm here.
The truth is, I want Moira to unwind. I think she really needs it.
She's been working overtime for weeks, and I can see the signs of burnout creeping up on her.
But you know how terribly serious she can be. I've never known anyone so determined to finish what she started.
Except you, maybe. Hahaha.
So, I'm on a secret mission to drag her out of the capital and bring her somewhere nice, like here.
Even Dr. Nestor knows, and agreed!
And I'm pretty sure she'll see through my act and chase me here. She's probably going to find me any minute now.
Moira! What a lovely coincidence!
Now, now, calm down. We don't want to make a scene.
I'm afraid not... But you're here now, and that's all that matters! You have to try the root beer here! It's heavenly!
I'm not joking either. I'll come with you after you've tried their drinks.
Just one glass, and we'll be on our way. Promise.
Perfect! You're joining us too, right, little Chemist?
Grizzly Guy! Two more root beers for my friends, please!
What? He looks strong, like a bear. It's a compliment.
I see... That's too bad. Now, tell me about your adventure!
She must've been really tired.
Whoopsie! I think that's our cue to go.
Thank you for your company, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}. And please apologise to the proprietor for the mess.
Do visit us in the capital sometime. See you again!

Dan is a hyperactive, childish man who believes he is a pirate and wishes to sail the high seas looking for treasure.

He has dissociative identity disorder, and thinks that his other personality, Dev, is a dullard.

{[CHARACTER_NAME]} discovered Dan wandering the beach all alone, searching for hidden treasure.

Dan asked whether {[CHARACTER_NAME]} wanted to take the treasure for themselves or join his pirate crew, and stormed away when he realised the chemist wasn't interested in any of it...

Dan is on a mission to find a "Legendary Cutlass".

He was very pleased when {[CHARACTER_NAME]} helped him succeed in his mission.

With a simple pirate ceremony, he then announced that {[CHARACTER_NAME]} was a formal member of his "pirate crew" and promised that they would soon set sail on the seven seas. That's how it seems, at least.
What's yer name, matey? People call me Captain Dan!
Do ye want to become me crewmate? Arr!
Don't disturb me, matey.
It's me day to search for treasure!
Shiver me timbers!
Blargh! A pirate's life is the life for me!
Arr, where's the gold? It must be hidden!
That sneaky lot! I'll crush their barnacles!
I need to get to me sea rover as soon as possible!
Where is it?
Arr! Have ye seen any gold around here?
Barnacles! Ye're as boring as Dev!
Avast! Captain Dan sailing through!
Ye should try becoming a pirate! Wahaha!
Ye and I should have a drink together, matey!
We have to talk about our next adventure... together!
What's up, crewmate?
Ready to weigh anchor? Arrr!
Do ye want to see me swinging me sword?
It would be quite a spectacle to see those landlubbers kneel before Captain Dan!
Ahoy! Thanks for the gift, matey!
Thanks for the gift. Shall we say cheers? Hahaha!
Ye surely know how to treat yer captain, matey! Cheers!
Me favourite thing! Ye have a good sense of taste, matey!
Matey. Are ye trying to bribe me or something? Try another day.
Thanks for the help! I'll get some rest before sailing the open seas again.
I feel better! Thank ye, matey!
Ugh... I still feel I'm at the bottom of the briny deep, but thanks...
A chemist from the capital? Arr! Show me what ye've got!
Make way for the great pirate!
Ahoy, matey! Nice to see ye!
Where is that mythical cutlass? It's supposed to be around here somewhere...
Could it be to the northeast?
Or the northwest...?
Who goes there?
Are you here to take what's rightfully mine?
Or are you here to rally under my flag?
You're not interested in either?
Tsk. People these days are so boring!
Landlubbers like you have no sense of adventure!
There's no place like the high seas!
And you know what...
You're as boring as Dev! There's someone else with no imagination.
Please! Trade yer legendary cutlass for me gold!
But ye can use gold to buy more materials and treasure!
Ye're being ridiculous, matey!
Out of me way, ye... foul landlubber!
Y-Ye want to give me this...?
Let me have a good look at it in me house!
This...
Ye bought this for me?
But... But...
I can't accept this.
A sea captain shouldn't accept anything from a landlubber like yerself!
Well, if ye insist...
Very well! I'll have to make an exception in this case.
Since I'm only willing to accept gifts from me own crew...
From now on...
Ye are an officially recognised member!
I will pass on me knowledge to ye.
And together we shall fight for our freedom!
Like pirates!
Let's begin yer inauguration.
As the first captain of the seven seas, I will begin the ceremony!
Wait here!
I'll find ye some clothing fit for a proper pirate!
Wh... Where are ye, matey?
Get back 'ere and put this on!
Ye and I are going to sail the seas together!
Make way, me hearties!
Yo-ho-ho! It's high time I found more coins for me treasure chest!
Yo-ho-ho! If it ain't the chemist from the Medical Association!
What are ye doing with me treasure chest, eh?
Ye're here for that leather briefcase? Not for me gold?
Suit yerself, matey! Take that boring briefcase with ye!
That's right! I took that briefcase from him.
And I'd do it again!
Ye know why? 'Cause he needs a break from that boring post office job!
His mind is always worrying about delivering, posting, whatever! Gimme a break!
Don't tell me that I don't care about boring old Dev!
A good captain like me always takes care of their crew, yarr!
A chemist?! Well, shiver me timbers! I've crewmates more competent than this 'ere novice!
Sink me, me hearties!
Well... I... I can explain...
I'm trying to... you know... make my own potion.
No, matey! Look!
I ain't stolen nothing. I just... borrow things.
I... I'm not too fond of this new chemist here!
When I saw them making a potion from these ingredients, I thought...
Why shouldn't I try it myself?
Because, y'know... it could make me stronger and all.
And I need to be stronger to carry on hunting for booty!
I'll pay you back later once I've got some loot in my pockets.
Please understand me, matey!
What do you say, matey? It takes special skill to mix them, right?
I... I'm sorry, matey... I thought I could make it work.
I'm sorry, matey, I really am...

Dean is Derrek's older twin brother. Both brothers work for the Moonbury's Police Department.

Dean is an honest and gentle man. A bit of a slacker, with a big appetite. He's trying his best to get fit for his job as a police officer.

Dean managed to muster all his courage and confessed to {[CHARACTER_NAME]} about his binge eating condition.

After the chemist helped him out with a concoction, Dean promised himself that he'd change for the better, starting with eating healthily and exercising.

But it'll definitely take him a while.

Dean is a little bit clumsy, and one day he makes a mistake that sends Osman into a rage.

Feeling he isn't good enough to be a police officer, Dean decides to quit. When Derrek hears the news, he goes to Dean.

Derrek and {[CHARACTER_NAME]} manage to talk Dean out of his decision, and he slowly regains his self-esteem, promising to become a better police officer.
A new face! I'm Dean, a police officer here in Moonbury.
Did you bring any snacks from the capital? Please let me have some!
Don't tell my twin brother, Derrek, though.
Hey, you. Do you like sweets?
If you know any good recipes, share them with me. OK?
H...Hey! What are you looking at? I'm not slacking off!
Don't tell Derrek! Ok?!
What? Do you have anything to report?
Hey, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}. It's a fine day to have a good meal, am I right?
Oh! I mean... uh... go for a walk and some exercise! Teehee...
Not eating enough can make you... demotivated.
I feel a little sleepy. A short nap wouldn't hurt...
Do I look slimmer to you?
I think my binge eating phase is over. Hopefully.
Whenever I feel both hungry and sleepy, I get confused...
You know, like, which one should I deal with first?
Sleeping or eating? Hmmm... Both are equally tempting.
I'm going to motivate myself to exercise by buying sweets after I work out.
Wait! I forgot that I need to cut down my sugar intake! Ah...
{[CHARACTER_NAME]}! I've managed to lose a few pounds recently.
It's not that visible, but it really gets me motivated!
Derrek and I would like to express our gratitude for your help!
Thank you for the gift, Chemist.
I love everything related to food and drinks. Thanks!
You shouldn't have...
I appreciate this gift. Thank you!
I can't receive your gifts over and over again... Thanks.
Wow... I feel so much better now. Thank you.
Thank you for curing me once again, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
I don't feel much different... Hmmm...
Hey, you'd better tread carefully! We're watching you.
Ah, hey, Chemist. How's it going?
Hello. Lovely day, isn't it?
Ahem! There's something I have to tell you.
It's a bit of a secret, so... follow me!
Let's keep our voices down, if you don't mind. I don't want anyone eavesdropping.
As you can see, with my poor lifestyle choices and eating habits, I'm hardly a model police officer.
I get sick and tired easily. I'm hungry most of the time.
I've wanted to change all that for so long....
But the temptation to eat unhealthy food and sweets is just too strong!
Is there a potion to help me control my binge eating?
Well, okay. I'll be around.
Let me know when you have the potion.
You've got the potion?
Perfect. Let's give it a go.
This is it?
Thank you so much, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}!
Once I'm in control of my eating, I'll have a body as buff as my brother's! Hahaha!
Huh? I'd still need to work out?
Hmm... I'll keep that in mind.
Fine. I'll try to eat a balanced diet and get some exercise.
At least I'll be able to cut down on my binge eating.
Y-Yes, sir...
Well...
You heard what just happened. I keep making mistakes, not like my brother.
Not only is he stronger than me, but I'm far worse at everything else than my brother.
I'm not good enough to be a police officer.
I'll go home and try to find the missing documents...
Could you deliver this to Derrek?
It's my police badge. Tell him that I quit.
I've had enough, Derrek. Being a police officer is too hard...
I can't live up to Osman's standards...

Let us know when you've got news.

So as you can see, our path is blocked by this geyser.
We've been investigating this place for a while.
So, one of the pipes here was badly damaged, and we couldn't find a replacement for it.
Can you help us fix this pipe?
Alright, here's the pipe.
Thanks for your assistance, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
The plants are dying.
I can't even remember what plants these used to be.
I'm afraid the plants will die soon.
Is there anything we can do about all this?
B-but...
Well...
Have you seen these bugs before?
If you take a look, you can see they must be the reason the plant's dying.
If we can't get rid of them, the plant will be a goner!
You want to help? Great!
First things first, we need more information about these bugs.
Maybe you could ask around town. I'm sure someone knows more than I do about them.
Well, well!
You really did get rid of all the bugs.
Now these plants can grow unhindered.
Victor helped you?
That's unexpected. I didn't know he was good with bugs.
Well, I hope they're gone for good.
Thank you for restoring some of our plants, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
{[CHARACTER_NAME]}, stop! Please turn around immediately.
What you can see here must be the fallout from an incident in the past.
We didn't even know about it until we fixed the geyser.
To be safe, please don't come here for the time being.
Do you have any idea what this is, though?
Hmm, I wonder if anyone knows anything about this.
For now, please stay away from this area, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
Oh, you need some help?
No problem. Tell me more.
So you might have found a way to bring the Aloe back?! That's amazing!
Hmm, but if it's going to involve digging, we'll have to get more tools. Ours are worn out.
Let's visit the blacksmith's, just in case they have some available.
Excuse me, we're looking for pickaxes to use in the Barren Wasteland. Do you have any in?
The geyser's been fixed now, so things have changed.
Hmm. So, could you make a new one?
I've still got my ranger work to do, so this isn't a great time for me to go hunting materials.
Any chance you could look for the materials instead, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}? Sorry...
Great! Once we've got the pickaxe, we can head straight over there.
Oh, the pickaxe is finished? That's good news.
Now, let's head to the Wasteland. I'll call Bubble too.
We're here to find out. Let's get this digging done together.
It was barely visible from the outside... Blink and you'd have missed it!
It probably happened when the geyser exploded.
It was the geyser that caused the landslide in Meadow Range too, remember?
This place is much closer than Meadow Range, so I'd guess it came off even worse.
Anyway, let's go inside now.
It's like old ruins in here.
The water's contaminated too. This doesn't look good.
Are you still going to investigate this place?
Okay, Bubble and I will head out now and report all this to Myer.
We'll pick this back up once you're done here.
Matheo, don't you remember the geyser exploding back then?
I believe the explosion caused a landslide and blocked the cave entrance.
Everyone, come outside and see this!
I'm glad we've managed to clear things up.
Certainly.
{[CHARACTER_NAME]}, there's bad news. Come with me.
As you can see, there are far more patients than usual.
A few patients have been moved away to be treated elsewhere.
We need you to help the remaining patients immediately.
The Clinic is already at capacity.

Garret owns the Farmhouse, and he's a family man who suffered from an accident a few years ago, forcing him to use a wheelchair.

His grumpy face is a true representation - he's always in a bad mood.

Garret is a stubborn old man, especially when it comes to his medication.

However, he does process all the information he receives, although it might take him longer than for other people.

Garret once suffered a serious accident that left him with an uncurable condition. His wife still believes he can be cured, however.

Garret sincerely hopes that Mercy can accept his condition and look to the future, not the past.

Even with his current condition, Garret is still the best version of himself when it comes to his family.
Hmph. Is there something you want, stranger?
Stop looking at me like that. This old timer has a name, and it's Garret!
Hey, what do you want?
Don't you have anything better to do? Hmph.
Laura won't stop talking about you.
Do anything to upset her, and you'll regret it.
A chemist? What does that mean?
Helping people? Bah! What nonsense.
Putting me in this stupid chair never helped me...
I wish I could turn back time.
Lucke and Laura are lucky to have each other.
They don't deserve a pathetic father like me...
I can't be expected to just accept this cruel fate.
You wouldn't understand...
I am so grateful for my family.
I may be disabled, but that won't stop me from being the head of my family.
Hmmm... I can finally focus on the positive things in life, and that's no bad thing.
Good day, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}. It's been a while.
My health seems to be better these days.
And my mood is improving as well. Thank you.
Pointless things... But thank you...
I don't really like presents, but thank you.
Why are you giving me this?
Thank you, I guess... It doesn't hurt to receive a gift sometimes, I suppose.
I don't need another gift from you. Come back tomorrow, and maybe my mood will have changed.
Well, your healing methods work just fine. Good job.
I'm feeling much better. Just... let me go home, will you?
Bah. What's the difference between your method and that witch doctor's?
Myer said a chemist from the capital would be different. Ha! What nonsense! Have you done anything worthwhile?
Oh, it's you.
You again? Hmpf... Hi.
Hmm? That newcomer, the chemist?
Why are you here? What do you want?
Tsk, Mercy shouldn't keep on bringing this up.
The only thing a chemist can do is put you in a blooming chair and walk away!
Make it quick.
I knew nothing would change.
They said the same thing when they last checked on me.
There's no use keeping this wretched old soul going.
You can leave now.
I said leave!
If they ask after me, just tell them that I'm alright.
Not again, Mercy...
Look... I know what that woman wanted when she called you here.
She kept searching for a way to get me up from this chair.
I understand her intention, but it's just impossible.
Things happened, and we can't turn back time because we want to.
I wish she would just accept me for who I am now.
So... whatever she asks you to do, just do it.
I'll play along for now.
This thing, you mean? Well... It tastes like chicken soup.
I feel nothing, Mercy. It's just chicken soup.
MERCY, ENOUGH!
You heard me. I said enough is enough.
Mercy, you have to listen to me. It happened, and I can never go back to being my former self.
You're the one who's running away from reality, Mercy.
We all know. The accident changed me.
I just want to move forward. To accept reality and be grateful that I'm still alive.
As long as I have you, Lucke and Laura.
That's all that matters to me.
Can we finally stop talking about the past and start moving forward together, Mercy?
Thank you, Mercy. Don't live in the past. There'll be better days from now on.
How many times have I told you that I'm not in the mood to eat!
Just put it on the table for later!
Give me a minute, Laura. I'm talking to your mum.
Of course. That was when Laura tried to imitate me when she was a baby.
Oh, my dear, of course! I promise!
Mercy, please forgive me for being so stubborn.
Hey, you!
Yeah, you!
Look...
None of our stock will touch their feed.
It's crawling with bloody maggots.
Help me get rid of these maggots, will you?
What?! They're not ordinary maggots?
Tsk... Just my luck.
Our sheep won't produce good-quality wool like this.
Is there anything you can do?
You want to do some research?
Good. You do whatever you need to.
So this is what you were talking about?
Good. I'll ask Lucke to apply it. Let's go over there.
Well, well! They ate every last bit.
You have your uses, don't you, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}?
The happier my sheep are, the better their wool will be.
But that said...
You've got to clean the hay feeder once a week, Lucke!
Such a sweet kid.
You should make something of yourself, get off this farm, and...
Is that because of me? I'm not exactly a father to be proud of...
Hey, you invited the chemist over.
You're trying to get {[CHARACTER_NAME]} to bulk-buy crops?
Well, you've built yourself a bit of a reputation!
Pffft... Look at this wheelchair. It's your design!
Are you going to tell me that you've been sitting around reading trash all this time, Lucke?
Now listen up.
Reading the odd book doesn't make you incapable of doing what you're good at.
Go and show Moonbury what a farmer's son like you can do with all this mechanical stuff.
I said, there's nothing wrong with it!
What do you want?
It's fine! I can still get around perfectly well. You don't need to change anything.
That's enough, Lucke. There's nothing wrong with it.
You'd better get back to work now!
Hmph. It... does feel better. Satisfied now? You must be just as stubborn as I am...
Now, don't forget to clean up before you shut up shop, alright? And... thank you, son.

Hannah is Nova's assistant at the Moonbury's Tailor Shop and has a keen eye for fashion.

She has a big vision when it comes to fashion, and hopes to be as good as her mentor one day.

One day, Hannah approached the chemist to seek advice about her disrupted sleeping pattern.

She finally found out that her bad relationship with her boss was the cause.

As an employee of Nova's, Hannah has always admired Nova's work.

But that's made it hard for Hannah to see the potential in her own work.

Nova realises Hannah has talent and proves it by making a dress designed by Hannah to instil her with confidence.
Hello there, sugar! The name's Hannah.
I know you're cute... but don't I look fabulous?
Oh. Hi, sugar.
Hope you're having a good day.
Please leave me alone.
I'm looking for inspiration for my work.
Oh? My hair?
Fabulous, right? I dyed it myself.
My hobbies other than fashion?
Sunbathing! Being soaked by the sun's warmth is so therapeutic.
It'd be wonderful to start my own fashion brand.
I'd make Nova so proud.
I can only dream...
Nova seems eccentric and scary at first.
But she has such passion for her art. I admire her!
She will always be my role model.
I can finally be proud of my work.
I hope lots of people like it.
Working in the fashion industry is challenging, but satisfying too.
Do you know any of the latest fashion trends from the capital?
Ah, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}. Seeing you brightens my day.
You give me courage, sugar. You're a wonderful person.
Thanks for the gift, sugar!
Is this really for me? Thanks!
How kind of you, sugar.
I will treasure this forever.
Sugar, this is too much. I can't accept this again.
Splendid work, sugar. I think the sickness has gone.
Thank you, sugar. I can start back at work tomorrow.
Sugar... Are you sure I'm cured already?
Chemist, huh? Interesting job. Let's see you do a magic trick, then.
What are you looking at, sugar?
Hello again, sugar. How do you do?
Oh, you came!
Thank you for taking my request on.
Anyway...
You know, I've been having difficulty sleeping over the past couple of months.
I really don't know what's behind it.
Can you suggest anything that might help?
Insomnia, hmm? Interesting...
It must be serious, right? I'm exhausted every day...
Would you be so kind as to make me a potion that could help?
You would? Awesome!
Thank you so much.
Do come again once you've got that potion for me!
You've made a potion for me?
Thank you! You're very kind.
I feel... the same. Is that normal?
Ah, yes! It should take effect later on. Around midnight?
This has got to fix my sleep schedule, right?
Wait. What did you say?
As long as there's something on my mind, I might still have trouble sleeping?
Hm... Yeah, I think I need to get things straight in my head.
Something has been really bothering me lately.
My boss, Nova.
She's the one who inspired me to join the fashion industry.
She's, like... one of my biggest inspirations.
But nothing I do is good enough.
We've argued so much these past couple of months, and I'm feeling very frustrated.
Different creative visions?
No, it's not that.
We've been on the same page since I started this job, and I've always believed in her vision.
She's a perfectionist, so there's always something about my work that doesn't meet her standards.
But, at the same time, I just want to feel appreciated for all the hard work I put in for her.
Maybe that's the reason for my lack of sleep lately...
Oh, look at me, rambling on. I talk too much!
Thank you for the potion, and for taking time to listen to me, of course.
I'll try my best to get through this.
You really like it?
I... I'm glad. It was based on one of Nova's designs like you requested.
T-Thank you for using our service!
Oh, fancy meeting you here. Come over here!
Did you see Helene with her new dress just now?
It's the same style as Nova's, but she wants me to personalise it a bit.
She said she liked it... of course... because it's Nova's design. Not mine...
She's a genius when it comes to fashion.
Compared to me...
Oh, it's okay. Don't think about it that much.
I did have some original designs, but...
I've never actually made them because I feel like they're not good enough.
So I'll research and study more so that I can become as good as her.
I... I know I need to practise more!
Well, gotta go! See you around!
Oh, hello, {[CHARACTER_NAME]} and Nova. What brings you here?
What is this? A dress?
Wait... This dress... Is this my design?
Nova, am I dreaming?
A-Are you sure about this Nova?
I will! I'll do my best from now on! Thank you!
The soft toys? Oh yes, I made them.
Is there anything you want?
A gift for Kipps? You're such a lovely person.
Here you are! I hope she loves the soft toy.
And don't worry, I'll give you this one for free!
I hope she likes it!
I did.
Oh, that belongs to Mariele. I did help her come up with the pattern.
But she rushed off home and left it behind.
Yes?
Oh my! So Mariele has been looking for this recently?
I should've given it to her earlier.
Would you please give it to her?
Please tell her that I kept it safe all this time.
When was the last time you went to the Willow Waters Bathhouse?
Did something happen?
Well, that was unfortunate.
Also, they've been using a special aroma lately. I tried it, but I won't be using it again.
A herbal scent. It's far too strong.
I felt like I was being boiled alive in a chemist's cauldron!
And it turned out gorgeous.

Helene is a relative newcomer to Moonbury. She is currently employed at the Arcade Centre in Moonbury's Tavern.

A master of tarot reading, she loves collecting antiques and rare gems.

Helene is very aware of her feminine charm, and loves to tease Dean about information she shouldn't know.

Especially information concerning prized artefacts.

Despite having come across so many fake artefacts during her life, she's adamant that one day she'll find something precious.

Having found out some interesting information, she then shared it with {[CHARACTER_NAME]} and checked it out.

Even though nothing came of it, Helene didn't mind, because she enjoys the process itself, regardless of the result.

Once again, Helene's lead failed to bear fruit, but that won't stop her from keeping on searching.

If getting rare items were easy, they wouldn't be nearly as valuable.

Helene also seemed to enjoy having {[CHARACTER_NAME]}'s company on her quest.
Hello, sweetheart. I'm Helene.
If you're into games, we've got some at the Arcade Centre. Teehee...
Hi there, sweetheart.
Are you enjoying your stay in this town?
(Sigh.) Those arcade machines...
I clean them just so they can get dirty again.
So, you're from the capital?
I hear there's an abundance of artefacts in the museum. Is that true?
Pretty is nice, but it's still just pretty. It's a necessity.
What is beauty without brains? A lady has to be smart and witty, too.
Just like the one in front of you.
I don't understand why tarot cards are seen as ominous.
On the contrary, the guidance in these cards has been quite helpful.
Hmm? Were you staring, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}?
Don't be shy. I know I'm gorgeous.
Please, go on. Feast your eyes on my beauty.
You've proved to me that this town isn't as mediocre as I thought.
The cards have told me to stay here a little longer.
Hmmm... The cards are drawn to you. I wonder why...
They say my tarot reading is eerily accurate.
I'll let you have a look for free...
In exchange... for a date.
Your face has a... delicate structure to it, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}. I've never noticed that before.
I always knew you were quick-witted, but this... Ah...
Come closer so that I can take a better look at you.
I thought finding artefacts was the only thing I could do to stave off boredom.
But it turns out that having you around is also great.
Knowing that you venture outside pretty often...
Sometimes it makes me worry about you, sweetie pie.
{[CHARACTER_NAME]}, I appreciate your company and everything you've done for me.
Truly, our relationship is more valuable than any gems or artefacts out there.
Thanks, sweetie-pie!
I'm more than happy to receive a gift from you.
Thanks very much, sweetie-pie!
I'll happily accept your gift.
Much appreciated. Love you!
Thank you for the sweet gift.
I like gifts, sweetie-pie. But I think it's a bit too much for now.
Sorry, I have to maintain the Arcade today. Maybe next time. Alright, sweetie pie?
My, my... You are a skilled chemist, aren't you? I feel so much better now.
Everything feels better. Thanks for helping me out, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
I'm not sure if I feel better or not, sweetie... But thank you.
Sorry, sweetie-pie. Let's have a drink after you show me you're for real.
Hi, sweetie. Got a good view?
Sweetie... Where are you going?
My sweet {[CHARACTER_NAME]}... You were in my dreams last night.
Hi, sweetie!
Are you free tonight?
What are you up to?
The Moon Stone? Tell me more.
Oh, it's nothing. Teehee...
I have to clean the arcade machines tonight.
Thanks anyway.
Are you here to play on the arcade machines?
Oh, you know everything? It's okay.
Come over here. I'll show you something interesting.
Let me use my tarot cards to read your fortune.
Have you had a tarot reading done before?
It's nothing to worry about, sweetheart. Let's begin.
This means that you're a person who keeps a lot of secrets.
Have you been naughty lately? Maybe you have a hidden agenda here in Moonbury?
I know you followed me when I was talking to Dean.
I'm just curious about artefacts. I'm no jewellery thief.
No need to be suspicious of me.
And don't be shy! Come and join in the conversation next time.
Why don't you help me find out more about the artefacts next time?
Remember your promise, sweetie pie!
Come on in!
I've gathered some juicy information lately.
I've been reading Dean's documents secretly, and I found something.
I think this document is classified.
Don't worry. I'll return everything without him knowing.
This document mentions an artefact called the "Moon Stone". It's located around Moonbury Island.
It also says there's a dig site near the Barren Wasteland where this artefact lies.
My gut tells me it might be something precious.
If you could help me locate the artefact, I'd be famous in no time.
Besides, you promised to help me last time, right, sweetie?
So, can you help me find the artefact?
Sweet! Come see me when you've found it.
You found it?!
Quick, follow me!
There's nothing special about this.
I thought it would be something cool...
But hey, at least you've found it for me, right, sweetie?
How about we take this artefact to Myer?
He might know something, given that the object is related to this island, don't you think?
Maybe he'll reward me with something, too.
All the information pointed to this stone.
No, I haven't! I just happened to read about a dig site on the Barren Wasteland! Haha...
What a shame!
But I'm glad that we discovered the truth about the past.
Well, thank you for your efforts in our little adventure and for believing me.
Would you be willing to help me out again sometime?
You know I need you by my side for my achievements.
Thank you, sweetie.
What do you mean? I was only having a healthy dialogue with him.
{[CHARACTER_NAME]}! Please help me. Derrek thinks I've been up to no good.
You really are a caring brother, you know?
Hey, it was a genuine compliment!
What a party pooper! What's the point of having all that information if you don't take any action?
Also, this one had better be legit...
Now, without further ado, let's check the place that was mentioned together, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}!
I have an important task to do. I'll be out for a bit.
Ah, about that... Can I do it later? I promise I'll finish it after this.
Fine. I'll do it right away.
That was unfortunate, sweetie pie. Looks like I'm going to be stuck here for a while.
I suppose you'll have to look for the treasure alone, again!
Oh, he said it's supposed to be somewhere on Glaze Iceberg.
Do you think you can find it?
Great! Good luck out there, sweetie pie.
You found it?
Quick, let's examine it together!
Finally, a real treasure chest!
I've waited years for this moment, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}!
Let's find out what's inside!
Oh, it's not actually locked!
It's... a beaker?
A shattered beaker...
It must have belonged to the previous chemist.
It could've been useful... but alas, it's broken.
What a shame.
Hey, have I ever told you why I'm so keen on collecting treasures?
At first, it was because of their beauty and value.
But it turns out that every treasure has its own fascinating, unique story.
Before I knew it, the journey of finding them itself had got me hooked.
And now, I've got a new reason to keep on going.
You have no idea how happy I am to have someone to share my passion with!
As for this item...
It would've been nice for you to have it if it had been intact.
It's of historical interest, after all, and belonged to the old chemist...
Oh, well. I'll clean it up later. Don't worry.
Before you go... About Dean...
It's true that I tried to pry the information out of him because I know he can't say no to me.
No wonder Derrek was upset.
What do you think? Am I a bad person?
Alright. I'll stop taking advantage of his feelings.
But I can't promise that I'll stop teasing him. He's a funny guy, after all.
Thank you, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
I'll look forward to our next adventure.
Absolutely! Let's get going, sweetie pie.
Of course! I was about to ask you too, actually.
Surprise me, love.
A Moon Brooch? For me?
Perhaps we'd better talk in private?
I'm surprised that this came from you.
To think that you're the one making a move here!
Do you really mean it, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}?
Moon Brooches are a lovely tradition, don't you think?
This is actually the first time I've been given one.
But I need you to convey your feelings for me even more clearly.
So I know whether you really are keen to find artefacts together with me.
And speaking of artefacts... I happen to have some new information.
I found it in Moonbury's archives.
I came across it by accident.
I was at the Town Hall, and saw a book on Xiao's desk.
Since I was bored, I gave it a read.
I didn't expect it to be that kind of book.
It didn't have many details in it, and it seemed pretty old.
But it's still worth investigating, don't you think?
Here are the details that I found.
Good luck, sweetie pie.
Why the long face?
Tell me all about it.
So it looks like there was nothing to be found in the area...
Are you sad that you didn't manage to get me anything?
Come here, sweetie pie.
There's nothing to be upset about.
I did mention how hunting for treasure is supposed to be fun, didn't I?
And this is just one small part of the process.
Besides, the information was pretty dubious to begin with.
This was just to make sure you really do enjoy searching for valuable stuff.
Though I would be lying if I said I wasn't hoping you'd find something, hahaha!
It's important to expect results like this throughout our journey.
Finally catching on, sweetie pie?
Our story has just begun.
Now, let's look forward to the journey that lies ahead, sweetheart.
Oh my! The dress I ordered is simply superb! Thanks, Hannah.
Of course! It's just as fancy as I wanted.
Whoa! It's kinda unusual to see you two hanging out and having fun together.
Since you're the busiest people in this town.
Yeah, sure Mister Workaholic... And you too, Chemist.
You both seem in tune with one another.
Hmmm... Since it's such a rare sight to see you both enjoying yourselves together...
How about... I read my tarot cards for you both?
Hmmm... Well, well, well... That's interesting.
My cards said both of you were born in the same constellation.
You have matching auras, and you synchronise easily.
You could both be very good working buddies.
Or even better as partners.
Sure. Come again, you two.
Hi there, sweetheart.
This is your first time here, isn't it?
Well, welcome to the Arcade Centre.
Feel free to play games here when you're bored.
Or maybe...
You can hang out with me if you're at a loose end.
What are you all doing?
No, I don't recall anything like that.
Zeke was the last person to come in.
A week ago, I think. It was an awful day.
Yeah, it started raining just after I left the place.
I got soaked on my way back home.
Oh, what kind of scent is it?
Sweetie, come on... I'm a grown woman. I can take care of myself.
Now, now... Are you worrying about me, sweetie?
Look... I have to look for that bright crystal, okay?
You know I love collecting gems, and that one is top of my list.
There's no need to worry about me.
Oh, well... How generous you are...
So, what do you think, Officer? Our dear chemist will help me look for it.
Wonderful. Please come and see me once you've got it.
I owe you one, sweetie pie.
You got the crystal for me?
Fabulous! Let's get together at the Arcade.
Thank you, Chemist!
You found the crystal for me, and it looks gorgeous!
Jealous, are we, sweetie?
Oh yes you are. You're jealous of our friend the chemist.
Let's have a drink some time, shall we, Dean?
It's on me.
Well... He's a silly boy. But rather sweet.
So, you don't have any new furniture designs this month?
I'm looking for something fancier, you know.
Something a bit more unique. The kind of thing you can't find anywhere else.
I want a breath of fresh air for my room!
Hmmm...
Well, sweetie... Your cooking is... How can I say it...
Outstanding.
You'll have to share the recipe with me, sweetie.
Of course, sweetie pie. But not too often.
Eating food this tasty, I'll put on weight in no time.
You know, my clothing collection requires me to keep my weight in check.
But it was an excellent meal, as I said.
Write down the recipe and give it to me, okay?
I've got to go now. Thanks for the treat!
Auntie?! Do you think I'm Nova or something? And why are you here anyway? Shouldn't you be studying right now?
Call me auntie once more and you'll regret it...
Hey there, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}!
If you're here to play, there's a certain someone here who's pretty sure no one can beat his high score. Care to challenge him?
Well, I did warn him.

Kipps is Zeke's black cat, whose appearance is often associated with the harbinger of misfortune.

In reality, this cat has brought nothing but joy to the residents of Moonbury. Everyone loves this little fur ball.

Sometimes Kipps gets in a bad mood, especially when people are late feeding her.

Zeke, who was penniless at the time, asked the chemist to help get her some grilled fish. The day's been saved, and Kipps is enjoying her favourite fish.

As a cat, Kipps likes to show affection by giving people presents. In this case, Kipps has brought {[CHARACTER_NAME]} a mouse.

Fully aware of Kipps' intention, {[CHARACTER_NAME]} decides to give her something in return.

Following Laura's suggestion, {[CHARACTER_NAME]} gives Kipps a soft toy that makes Kipps' little feet dance.
There's a tag on the cat's collar.
It says, "Kipps. This cat belongs to Zeke. Please do not feed - she has food allergy."
Meow?
Meow...
Hiss!
Meow! Mrow.
Maw. Maw. Meow.
Meow?
Mrow. Maw. Maw.
Meow...

Now, the only thing left is the materials.
Could you collect them for me, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}?
Thanks.
Great, you've collected them all.
I'll go and make the pipe right away.
I might be able to finish this by tomorrow.
Just drop by the Tavern.
Oh, you're here.
I've finished the pipe. Come with me.
Here it is.
It's slightly different from the one you brought me.
It's tougher and firmer.
Definitely much better than the old one.
I think I should make some more for the Tavern, as well.
This should be strong enough to hold the geyser back.
Welcome, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
Have a seat. What would you like to drink?
A note?
I see. It's the wine Victor ordered.
Well, I'm still preparing it. Maybe you could get those flowers first.
Hmm? Here in the note he asked you to get some flowers too.
Come back here when you've found them.
I'll make sure the wine's ready by the time you get back.
Okay, I've finished packaging it up.
Here you go.
Oh, it's you. Are you looking for Martha?
She's still in her room. She'll be coming downstairs soon. You can wait here.
Anyway...
She doesn't seem to be in a very good mood, but I don't know why.
Could you cheer her up, maybe?
See? She's been in a bad mood lately. You'd better go to her room and cheer her up.
She just ran outside.
Your conversation didn't go well, huh?
You'd better chase after her. And be patient, okay?
Wait. She spent all night making this basket of cookies.
I think she made this for you. You'd better take this with you.
Do you need something from me...?
Hey, get back here!
You see Kipps just then?
Wow. She was... fast.
Looks like Martha forgot to close the door.
She took my secret recipe book upstairs.
Oh hey, that's my recipe book.
That was lucky. Nobody's seen it.
W-wait...
Y-you didn't read my book, did you...?
Fine... I'm making a different recipe from now on...
Where are you going?
What about the arcade machine? Are you done with the maintenance?
No, you promised to have it finished yesterday.

Zeke is a carefree homeless man with a happy-go-lucky outlook who knows how to live for the day.

He is usually found napping on a park bench. His most precious possession and the only family member who matters to him is his black cat, Kipps.

It turns out that Zeke was once quite an important personage. Myer has known him for quite some time.

He was once a famous merchant in the capital but, after a mysterious incident, he chose to live like a nobody in the peaceful town of Moonbury.

Myer has a pretty odd, but apparently very important request for Zeke.

He asks Zeke to retrieve a book from the capital, but Zeke can only do that with {[CHARACTER_NAME]}'s help.
Yes? Oh, the chemist...
I'm Zeke. This town is lovely, isn't it?
It's better than the capital... in every way.
Chemist, do you like cats?
You'd better.
Have you met Kipps, my cat?
Do you have any spare change?
Anything would help.
What a good day to doze off on... Don't you think?
Living like this isn't as bad as you might think, you know?
There's nothing to worry about.
Did you ever grow tired of living in the capital?
I've been there, and I'd say it's pretty stressful.
It's a fine day, and the air is fresh. What more can you ask for?
You need to enjoy life to the fullest, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}!
I hope the merchant I contacted last time doesn't try to find me again.
I've said farewell to being busy! I'm now taking a peaceful break.
{[CHARACTER_NAME]}! You look quite lively today.
You remind me of when I was a young chap. I was ambitious back then. Always aiming for the top.
You really know what this old man needs! Thank you.
Thank you for your kindness.
This is something I'd never find in the capital. Thanks!
What a lovely gift! Thank you so much, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
Ah... No, thanks. If I accept another gift off you, people will think I'm greedy.
I can tell my sickness has gone completely thanks to you.
I really miss Kipps. She must be waiting for me at home. Thanks, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
My old bones are still screaming at me. Are you certain that I'm well?
This might sound rude, but you need to prove yourself, Chemist.
Oh, young Chemist. Any luck with your work?
Hey, how are you? I hope you're having a good day.
Hey, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}, over here. Good timing!
Could you please look after Kipps for a while? I have something to do.
Kipps, stay with {[CHARACTER_NAME]} and be a good girl, okay?
I have to agree, Myer.
The real surprise is that you became the mayor! How did that happen?
Nah, I gave that up. Besides, I'm just a poor old man, you see? Haha!
Ohoho! Look who's here. Did my little Kipps come to pick me up, then?
Any time, my friend.
Myer, I thought we had a deal...
Was Kipps a good girl?
Thanks for that, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
I told you already. I'm retired, Myer...
I'm not so sure about that.
That's not fair, Myer... You're putting me on the spot...
Wait... Maybe {[CHARACTER_NAME]} could help us.
Look, the merchant who has your book has had a hair problem for a while.
He has always wanted to grow some hair ever since my days as a merchant.
If we can fix that problem, I can try to negotiate with him.
It all depends on {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
Oh, is the potion ready?
Let's hope this bottle of yours works perfectly.
I'm gonna send this right away.
It's been a while for me. Time to get to work!
Hey! We got a reply just now.
Come with me to the Town Hall.
And there he goes.
Now we're finished, let's head back, shall we?
Did everything go smoothly?
You know, I actually came from the capital too.
I was a merchant back there, and quite a successful one, I must say.
But my success quickly become meaningless, as it just made me more worried each day.
Finally, I decided to retire and leave everything behind, except Kipps.
And look at me now, here in Moonbury living a carefree, simple life.
It suits me very well, don't you think? Haha!
I guess I've been yammering on for too long. I'll see you around!
Thanks for the help earlier.
Oh, it's you, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
Kipps is mad at me.
Today is actually her special day.
I always bring her a grilled fish from Ottmar, but I can't afford it right now.
Would you help me get her a treat, please?
You managed to get some grilled fish?
Let's go and give it to Kipps.
Haha! Kipps is loving it.
Thanks for helping her out.
Oh! Hello, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
A package? Yes, I found a package at the Arcade Centre.
I planned to hand it in at the Police Department, but Kipps pinched it and then ran off.
By the time I'd found her, the package was a total mess.
All that's left of it is this box. I'm afraid something is missing... The package was heavier before.
You can take the box.
I can use this to cook something for us.
Oh, hello, {[CHARACTER_NAME]}.
We're looking for some ingredients for dinner.
I've been doing a lot of foraging lately.
I was thinking I'd cook something different for Kipps.
She needs to eat something other than fish once in a while, you know.
Right, Kipps?
But I've been unable to find the bluish-white berry I need for my recipe.
I've searched the area from top to bottom, but no luck.
In the days before I moved to this island, those berries were everywhere.
And I used to put them in pretty much all my recipes.
Anyway, I suppose I'll just have to keep looking.
Come on, let's go and investigate somewhere else.
Hmmm... You want to give me this?
Oh! It's the berry I've been looking for.
Now I can cook the dish I've been wanting to make.
These berries... It's been a while since I last saw a delicacy like these.
Where did you get them?
Glaze Iceberg?
Well, I've never been there before.
That must have been quite the journey.
Well, now I can start making something with the berries. I'll give you a taste, alright?
It won't take long, I promise.
Wait here.
Here you go.
My special salad!
I used to cook this dish back when I was your age.
It's easy to make, tasty, and most definitely healthy!
Have you ever cooked something like this before?
Well, you should!
It'll come in handy, and it's easy to prepare.
Besides, it's packed with nutrients to keep you full of energy all day.
Now, what are you waiting for?
Let's eat!
Thank you, Sister.
Kipps loves you too, and you're welcome, Laura.
She is a lovely girl, isn't she?
I used to know a sweet little child just like her, with a kind family, back when I was still...
Well, not like this.
Perhaps that's a story for another time, but... what I mean to say is, they're good people.
Perhaps I should give them something in return.
Don't you think? Kipps? {[CHARACTER_NAME]}?
So tell me... What would the best gift be for a lovely child like Laura and her family...?
Hmm...
Oh, I know!
This is the season when sunflowers start blooming in the field.
If you're going out to the field, could you please pick some for Laura?
I'd like to give her them as a gift.
I'll be expecting you soon.
Hi, what is it?
You've got the sunflowers?
Perfect. Let's give them to her.
Looks like you two are having a good time.
We love it, Laura.
And since the soup was so delicious...
I have something for you and your mama.
Of course you can, my dear. One for you and one for your mama.
Hahaha! Be careful on your way back, and please say thanks to her again.
Ah... another smile means another bright day.
Isn't that right, Chemist?
Thank you for the sunflowers.
You've made this old man's day brighter too.
May your day be a good one.
